name: Dried cranberry
description: Cranberries dried with a great deal of added sugar, because they are inedible otherwise.

tcm.note: Follows cranberry; a new-world fruit with no classical entry.

histamine.note: Dried, sweetened and sour — several contributors at once.

effects.note: A 12-week trial gave older adults freeze-dried cranberry equivalent to about a cup of fresh cranberries a day — close to what dried cranberries deliver before the added sugar — and found improved short-term and episodic memory alongside increased blood flow to memory-related brain regions, though the same trial found no significant change on attention tests specifically. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
